title: Claims Time Limits and Service Standards for BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies
content:
The claim time limits and service standards for BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines) are fixed per tier: the days after the date of loss within which the proof of loss must be received, the days after the agreed proof of loss within which Tidemark pays, Tidemark's standard for the adjuster's first contact, the months after a written denial within which suit may be filed, and whether either party may demand appraisal.

## Standards

| Tier | Proof of loss received within (calendar days of the date of loss) | Payment within (calendar days of the agreed proof of loss) | Adjuster's first contact (elapsed hours) | Suit filed within (calendar months of the written denial) | Appraisal may be demanded by either party |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BizFlood Building | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |
| BizFlood Building and Contents | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |
| BizFlood Building, Contents and Business Income | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |
| BizFlood Excess over NFIP | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |
| BizFlood Multi-Location | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |
| BizFlood Large Property | 90 | 30 | 48 | 24 | Yes |

## Units at a glance

- Proof of loss and payment periods are calendar days; the adjuster contact standard is elapsed hours; the suit period is calendar months.
- The figures are identical on all six tiers.

## Counting illustration (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical date of loss of 1 September, the 90th calendar day after the date of loss is 30 November. For a hypothetical written denial dated 15 March of one year, 24 calendar months later is 15 March two years on.
